"""Telemetry metric streaming normalizer."""
import logging
from typing import Dict, Any

from key_normalizer import extract_normalized_keys
from wire_envelope import build_envelope, is_valid_envelope

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def prepare_metric_packet(data: Dict[str, Any], epoch_ms: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Prepare telemetry metric packet for distribution to event stream."""
    return dict(data)


def publish_stream_packet(data: Dict[str, Any], epoch_ms: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    pkt = prepare_metric_packet(data, epoch_ms)
    
    # Extract normalized keys for context (P06 requirement for contextual attributes)
    normalized_keys = extract_normalized_keys(data)
    
    # Build a valid wire envelope to fix incident STREAM-105
    # Using default service name as one is not provided in signature
    envelope = build_envelope("telemetry-stream", epoch_ms, pkt)
    
    logger.info(
        "Published telemetry packet",
        extra={
            "keys": normalized_keys,
            "valid": is_valid_envelope(envelope),
        },
    )
    
    return envelope
=== END ===
